name: comp-506
blurb: Calendar with quick-preset buttons for common date ranges.
description: A calendar with preset shortcuts on the left (Today, Yesterday, Last week, Last month, Last year). Clicking a preset sets both the calendar view and selected date. Only past dates are selectable.
use_when: Users often need to pick dates from recent history and appreciate quick shortcuts.
avoid_when: When future dates are needed — the component disables all future selections.
a11y: Uses aria-live for announcements. Buttons and calendar navigation are keyboard-accessible.
